# Public dependency provenance

`HoTT_HIT_Metatheory/` is an unmodified extraction of the official Archive of
Formal Proofs source archive downloaded on 2026-11-12:

- Entry: https://isa-afp.org/entries/HoTT_HIT_Metatheory.html
- Archive: https://isa-afp.org/release/afp-HoTT_HIT_Metatheory-current.tar.gz
- Archive SHA256: `a085bb91380abf30f4a3cf744736835b74847d34d1d7388c8bcfd582c519536a`
- License: https://isa-afp.org/LICENSE (verbatim copy in `AFP-LICENSE`).
- Authors: Arthur Freitas Ramos, David Barros Hulak, Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz.

The upstream archive URL is mutable. This repository pins its contents instead
of downloading an unverified newer version during a build. The 17 source files
are exactly those in the downloaded public archive. `SHA256SUMS` records every
vendored source file and the original AFP license; run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`
from this directory to verify them. No private repository source or history is
included in this dependency snapshot.

The dependency remains the authors' published work; this redistribution does
not imply AFP endorsement or submission/acceptance of the dependent-family extension.
